units.source_text: 藤壶母后非常痛苦，说话也很困难，只是心中寻思：

en.t: Empress Mother Fujitsubo was in great pain, and even speaking was difficult for her; she could only think silently to herself:

units.source_text: “此身因有宿世深缘，故在这世间享尽尊荣富贵，人莫能及。

en.t: “Because of deep karmic ties from former lives, I have enjoyed honor, rank, wealth, and splendor in this world beyond anyone else.

units.source_text: 然而我心中无限痛苦，亦复世无其匹！

en.t: Yet the suffering in my heart is boundless, and in that too no one in the world can equal me!

units.source_text: 冷泉帝做梦也不曾想到此种秘密，实在对他不起。

en.t: Emperor Reizei has never dreamed of such a secret, and I have truly wronged him.

units.source_text: 惟有此恨，使我死不瞑目。

en.t: This one regret alone will keep me from closing my eyes in death.

units.source_text: 海枯石烂，永无消解之一日了！”

en.t: Even if the seas dry up and stones crumble, there will never be a day when it is resolved!”

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣为朝廷着想，太政大臣新丧，藤壶母后垂危，连遭不幸，实甚可悲。

en.t: Thinking of the court, Genji, the Inner Minister, found it deeply tragic that the Grand Minister had only just died and Empress Mother Fujitsubo now lay near death, one misfortune following another.

units.source_text: 而想起了自己与藤壶母后的秘密私情，又觉无限伤心。

en.t: And when he remembered his own secret affair with Empress Mother Fujitsubo, his sorrow became immeasurable.

units.source_text: 于是尽心竭力，大办佛事，祈祷母后早日恢复健康。

en.t: He therefore devoted all his strength to arranging grand Buddhist rites and prayed that the Empress Mother would soon recover her health.

units.source_text: 他对藤壶母后的恋情，年来久已断绝。

en.t: His love for Empress Mother Fujitsubo had long since been severed over the years.

units.source_text: 想起了今生永无再续鸾胶之一日，心中非常悲痛。

en.t: But when he thought that in this life there would never again be a day when their bond could be renewed, his heart was filled with grief.

units.source_text: 便走近病床前的帷屏旁边，向知情的侍女探询母后病状。

en.t: He went near the curtain beside her sickbed and asked a lady-in-waiting who knew the circumstances about the Empress Mother’s condition.

units.source_text: 母后身边的侍女，都是亲信之人，察知源氏内大臣衷情，便将母后近状详细奉告。

en.t: The attendants at the Empress Mother’s side were all trusted women, and perceiving Genji’s true feelings, they reported her recent condition to him in detail.

units.source_text: 又道：

en.t: They also said:

units.source_text: “近几月来，即使身体不适，礼佛诵经之事亦不间断。

en.t: “For the past few months, even when she has felt unwell, she has never stopped worshiping the Buddha or reciting sutras.

units.source_text: 积劳既久，身体更形衰弱。

en.t: After such long accumulated strain, her body has grown still weaker.

units.source_text: 近日橘子汁也绝不进口，看来已无希望了。”

en.t: Lately she will not even take mandarin juice, and it seems there is no hope left.”

units.source_text: 众侍女无不掩面而泣。

en.t: All the attendants covered their faces and wept.

units.source_text: 藤壶母后命侍女传言道：

en.t: Empress Mother Fujitsubo had an attendant convey these words:

units.source_text: “你恪守父皇遗命，为今上效忠，不遗余力。

en.t: “You have faithfully observed my late father the Emperor’s command and have served the present sovereign with all your strength.

units.source_text: 年来受惠甚多，我常思俟有良机，向你表达感谢之忱。

en.t: For years I have received much kindness from you, and I have always wished to find a proper occasion to express my gratitude.

units.source_text: 静候至今，岂料病势沉重至此，遗憾在心，夫复何言！”

en.t: I waited quietly until now, never imagining that my illness would become so grave; with this regret in my heart, what more can I say!”

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣在帷屏外微闻声息，伤心之极，不能作答，只是吞声痛哭。

en.t: Outside the curtain, Genji, the Inner Minister, faintly heard her voice; overcome with sorrow, he could not answer and only sobbed in silence.

units.source_text: 自念心情何以如此脆弱，应该顾忌他人注目，振作起来。

en.t: He told himself that his heart should not be so weak, and that he ought to consider the eyes of others and pull himself together.

units.source_text: 但又想起藤壶母后从前的美貌，世间一般人见了也不胜怜惜。

en.t: But then he remembered Empress Mother Fujitsubo’s former beauty, which would have moved even ordinary people in the world to boundless pity.

units.source_text: 岂料如今即将香消玉殒，无法挽留，真乃抱恨终天之事！

en.t: Who could have expected that she would now be about to fade and die, impossible to keep back; it was truly a grief he would carry to the end of his days.

units.source_text: 终于收泪答道：

en.t: At last he held back his tears and replied:

units.source_text: “驽钝之材，诚不足道。

en.t: “I am a dull and worthless person, truly not worth speaking of.

units.source_text: 惟受命以来，竭力效忠，不敢怠慢。

en.t: Yet since receiving the command, I have done my utmost to serve loyally and have not dared to be negligent.

units.source_text: 月前太政大臣遽尔逝世，此后身荷政务重任，益增惶恐。

en.t: Last month the Grand Minister suddenly passed away, and since then the heavy burden of government has fallen on me, increasing my fear all the more.

units.source_text: 岂料母后今又患病，更觉心乱如麻。

en.t: Now, unexpectedly, the Empress Mother has fallen ill as well, and my heart is more tangled than ever.

units.source_text: 深恐此身亦不能久居人世也。”

en.t: I deeply fear that I too may not remain long in this world.”

units.source_text: 在这期间，藤壶母后就像油干火绝一般悄悄地断气了。

en.t: During this time, Empress Mother Fujitsubo quietly breathed her last, like a lamp going out when its oil is spent.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣的悲伤不可言喻。

en.t: The grief of Genji, the Inner Minister, was beyond words.
